description: Default verification commands run by /web-modernize:verify. Edit per-project to match your target stack. The plugin substitutes ${target_path} with the unit's target_paths made RELATIVE to the subsystem root (${ui_root}/${api_root}) they live under, then joined by space — because these commands run the test tool with its cwd already at that root (via --prefix), a repo-root-relative path would double the prefix. It substitutes ${ui_root}/${api_root} with the paths from state.json.scaffold.

dynamic._comment: Opt-in higher-fidelity tier run by /web-modernize:verify --dynamic. ADVISORY — never blocks. Populated by /scaffold when 'Dynamic testing' is enabled in migration.md §12; null/empty entries are skipped with setup guidance.
